38/S0.subgoal: Orient the learner to the design stage of the interactive system development lifecycle and explain why the lecture focuses on interface and interaction design rather than code design.

38/S1.subgoal: Describe the basic aspects of interface and interaction design: where to start and how design ideas are represented.

38/S2.subgoal: Distinguish specific from generic design guidelines and introduce Shneiderman's Eight Golden Rules as a generic starting point.

38/S3.subgoal: Explain Shneiderman's first two golden rules, consistency and universal usability.

38/S4.subgoal: Explain the golden rules of informative feedback and task closure.

38/S5.subgoal: Explain the golden rules of error prevention and easy reversal of actions.

38/S6.subgoal: Explain the golden rules of user control and short-term memory load, and assess their applicability to extended reality systems.

38/S7.subgoal: Outline the broad categories of XR interaction and summarize the main points of the lecture.
